text:
Maya (marketing): T-minus 72hrs — final coordination thread for the release day runbook. Need: changelog drop link, docs anchor to lock in, webinar slot confirmation, demo CTA URL, and where inbound leads should route. Short replies pls. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam (eng): Changelog will be cut from the release branch tonight. I can drop the public changelog link by EOD. Canary window is 09:00-11:00 PDT on launch day. Any objections to that?

Jordan (product): Canary window OK for us. QA will run the regression set at 08:00 so we have an hour buffer. For docs, we need the anchor for the new "dedicated" section — prefer /docs/release/v2#dedicated-instances.

Maya (marketing): Perfect. So action items: Sam -> changelog URL, Jordan -> confirm docs anchor + short blurb, Eli -> confirm webinar slot and demo CTA landing.

Eli (ops): Webinar slot confirmed with events: 10:30 PDT (20 min demo + 15 min Q&A). I'll reserve the speaker calendar and Get the live Q&A channel ready. Demo CTA URL — do we want a short-lived tracking query? e.g., https://try.redwood.ai/launch?src=webinar

Alejandra (sales): For inbound leads, route to HubSpot workflow "Launch_Webinar_Inbound" — please ensure the webhook includes: lead_source=webinar, campaign=launch_v2. Also add a routing rule: tier leads with >50 monthly MAU -> AE assign, else MQL nurture.

Sam (eng): Changelog draft: https://internal.redwood/release/1748135792/changelog-draft.md (internal) — I'll publish the public one at https://redwood.ai/changelog/launch-v2 by 18:00 PT. Note: there is a short note in the runtime section about adaptive batching that product asked to soften; Jordan please review.

Jordan (product): I'll review in 30m. Docs anchor confirmed: published PR merged -> https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2#dedicated-instances. Blurb for marketing (one-liner): "Dedicated pools and smarter routing reduce inference cost and improve tail latency for production workloads." Keep it editable.

Maya (marketing): Nice. Draft social + launch post will use that line. Can someone paste the final benchmark chart link we referenced in the blog? Need SVG and PNG for assets.

Sam (eng): Benchmark artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/launch-v2/benchmarks/summary.svg and summary.png. Note: numbers are median latency at 2k tokens — documented in the appendix.

Eli (ops): On the routing side — HubSpot webhook endpoint ready: https://hooks.redwood.ai/hubspot/launch-webinar. I will enable a short replay capture to attach recordings to the lead record.

Alejandra (sales): Great. For the demo CTA we prefer the landing to prefill company size and use campaign tag: /try.redwood?src=webinar&campaign=launch_v2 — can we make that the canonical CTA?

Eli (ops): Yes, will map query params into the HubSpot payload. Also adding UTM parameters for analytics.

Maya (marketing): Two more asks: 1) Can we pin a short changelog summary at the top of the blog and link to the full public changelog? 2) We need one-sentence blurbs for the webinar intro slide per feature (runtime, routing, dedicated capacity). Jordan, Sam, can you give me two lines each by EOD?

Sam (eng): I'll send two lines now: 
- "Runtime: 20% lower median latency via adaptive batching and cache-aware kernels."
- "Routing: automatic fallback to lower-cost variants preserves availability under load."

Jordan (product): My two lines: 
- "Dedicated capacity: predictable throughput and isolation for enterprise workloads."
- "Optimize: tooling to recommend quantization & batching profiles per workload."

Maya (marketing): Perfect. Last plumbing check: is there a deploy-blocking issue open?

DeployBot: deploy-check: no blocking issues found for release/launch-v2. Canary job scheduled at 09:00 PDT on 1748215200. Status: green. :white_check_mark:

Sam (eng): Small note — we'll enable a temporary rollback policy in the canary to automatically switch to the previous model variant if error rate > 2% for 5 minutes. Ops will monitor.

Eli (ops): Monitoring runbooks updated and alerts set: #incidents + pager if latency > 750ms p95. I'll post the runbook link in this thread when it's live.

Maya (marketing): Thanks all — I'll assemble the final launch email and social schedule after the public changelog link lands. If anyone posts changes, ping here. :rocket: 

Alejandra (sales): I'll prep an AE playbook for the first 48hrs of leads and put in shared drive.

Maya (marketing): Closing checklist for this thread: public changelog URL, docs anchor verified, webinar slot confirmed, benchmark assets linked, demo CTA canonical, HubSpot webhook ready. If all thumbs up by 18:00 PT we go live with the announcement tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Sam (eng): 👍
Jordan (product): 👍
Eli (ops): 👍
Alejandra (sales): 👍
DeployBot: scheduled canary job will run as planned.
